scope: Japanese S8a main booster openings; English Celebrations and S8a-P promos are excluded from the denominators.
counting_unit: One V-UNION event is one complete set of four pieces. VMAX is one card/event.
policy: Public convenience samples, not randomized trials or Korean official pull rates. Unknown counts remain null. Carton aggregates do not establish per-box guarantees or multiplicity distributions.

new_main_booster_records.creator: モルさんと!#コンプオフ
new_main_booster_records.denominator_basis: Creator identifies the opening as one carton. Twenty boxes per S8a carton is cross-checked against the retailer's own product listing, rather than inferred from the hit counts. The opening shot shows ten top-layer boxes; all twenty individual box summaries are not shown.
new_main_booster_records.limits: Reported whole-carton counts were visually transcribed from the final on-screen tally. Only the first two individual box summaries are available. They are a subset of the carton and must not be added again. The title describes poor luck; this is not a random sample. Print run is unverified. Fifteen sets does not prove fifteen distinct boxes contained a set.

confirmed_model_issues: Current independent per-pack model expects 16/13 = 1.230769 V-UNION sets per box; the new carton reports 0.75 and the descriptive 28-box sum is 0.678571.
Current VMAX plus V-UNION mean is 36/13 = 2.769231 events per box; the new carton reports 40/20 = 2.0 events per box.
A mutually exclusive single SR-or-UR slot cannot produce the carton's second box, which visibly contains both SR and UR.
Six SR cards displayed from five boxes contradict a universal exactly-one-high-card-per-box rule.
